interactions.note: The epitope was determined from the crystal structure of Fab TN1 bound to the receptor-binding domain of human TPO. There are four molecules in the crystallographic asymmetric unit. PDB chains for each complex are: Complex I : Antibody heavy-chain: H, Antibody light-chain: L, epitope chain: V. Complex II : Antibody heavy-chain: I, Antibody light-chain: M, epitope chain: X. Complex III : Antibody heavy-chain: J, Antibody light-chain: N, epitope chain: Y.  Complex IV : Antibody heavy-chain: K, Antibody light-chain: O, epitope chain: Z. The crystal structure belongs to space group P21. In the epitope molecule, residues 1-6 and 152-163 could not be distinguished in electron density maps and were omitted from the model.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.3 angstroms

The epitope was determined from the crystal structure of Fab TN1 bound to the receptor-binding domain of human TPO. There are two molecules in the crystallographic asymmetric unit. PDB chains for each complex are: Complex I : Antibody heavy-chain: H, Antibody light-chain: L, epitope chain: V. Complex II : Antibody heavy-chain: I, Antibody light-chain: M, epitope chain: X.The crystal structure belongs to space group C2.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.5 angstroms

The binding of epitope-specific Fab TN1 to fragment hTPO 1-163 occluded the low affinity binding site on the c-Mpl receptor, as measured by isothermal titration calorimetry. The association constant of hTPO 163 and TN1 is about 1 nM, whereas, that of c-Mpl at the low affinity site is about 1 µM, explaining the strong neutralizing activity of TN1.; Unmapped quantitative response: association constant KA 1 1/nM
